events.title: A Petition to the King
events.text: The Drowned King sits in a flooded throne room, still hearing petitions. 'You may ask one thing of us. We will ask one thing of you.'

options.label: Ask for his blessing
options.result: He blesses you. Next fight, your party starts warded. He will remember the debt.

options.label: Ask for his treasury
options.result: He gives you all of it. It was never the gold he cared about. A new rule: Blood Money.

options.label: Ask for nothing
options.result: He is surprised. Nobody has asked for nothing in a long time.

events.title: The Ferry
events.text: A ferry where a street used to be. 'Across is a coin each. Or I can take you under, which is free.'

options.label: Pay the fare (20 gold)
options.result: A quiet crossing. You rest on the way.

options.label: Go under
options.result: Cold and dark and something shiny at the bottom.

events.title: The Sunken Bell
events.text: A church bell under the water. When the current moves it, it rings, and every drowned thing for miles looks up.

options.label: Ring it
options.result: Everything hears. The next fight is an elite. The bell's clapper comes away in your hand.

options.label: Muffle it
options.result: You pack it with weed. Next fight, the drowned are slower to wake: enemies have 15% less HP.

events.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
events.text: A lighthouse with no sea to warn. The keeper keeps the lamp lit anyway. 'Somebody might need it.'

options.label: Help him trim the lamp
options.result: He gives you a bottle of lamp oil for your trouble.

options.label: Take the lens
options.result: The light goes out. He doesn't say anything. He just sits in the dark.

options.label: Sleep in the lamp room
options.result: The warmest place in the kingdom.

events.title: An Oath Stone
events.text: A stone where the drowned knights swore their oaths. Fresh water drips off it, though it is high and dry.

options.label: Swear an oath of protection
options.result: You feel the oath settle. It is heavy.

options.label: Swear an oath of vengeance
options.result: You will make someone pay. It has already cost you.

options.label: Break an old oath
options.result: Somebody's broken promise pays out. It follows you.

events.title: The Floating Market
events.text: Rafts tied together into a market. Everything is a little wet and a little cheaper.

options.label: Shop
options.result: Damp bargains.

options.label: Trade a card for fish
options.result: Very fresh fish.

check.pass_text: Somebody's stall floats away with you.

events.title: The Child in the Window
events.text: A drowned child waves from an upstairs window, under the water. It wants you to come in and play.

options.label: Wave back
options.result: It smiles and swims away. You feel watched over. Next fight your party starts blessed.

check.pass_text: It shows you its toys. One of them it lets you keep.

fail.cause: stayed to play under the water

check.fail_text: It wanted to play for a very long time.

events.title: The Eel Pit
events.text: A pit full of eels and, at the bottom, a sword with a crown on the pommel.

check.pass_text: You get it. The crown on the pommel was gold.

options.label: Feed the eels
options.result: Distracted, they let you take a smaller prize from the edge.

events.title: Tide Tables
events.text: A soaked book of tide tables. Someone has circled tomorrow's high water in red.

options.label: Study it
options.result: You understand the water better now.

options.label: Plan around it
options.result: Next fight your party starts hasted, moving with the tide.

options.label: Burn it for warmth
options.result: Soggy, but it burns eventually.

events.title: The Wreck
events.text: A ship wrecked in a ballroom. Its cargo is still sealed.

options.label: Salvage the timber
options.result: You patch your armour with ship's oak.

events.title: The Frog Choir
events.text: A choir of frogs on lily pads, singing something you almost recognise. The Caller hums along.

options.label: Listen to the end
options.result: It's a lullaby. It works.

check.pass_text: They accept you into the choir. Something steadies in you.
check.fail_text: Wrong key. The frogs are very disappointed.

options.label: Catch frogs
options.result: Someone at the market will buy them.

events.title: The Crown in the Mud
events.text: A crown, half buried in the mud. The Drowned King's voice: 'That is mine. I would like it back. I would like it very much.'

options.label: Return it to him
options.result: He gives you something from his treasury, and the drowned are quieter for a while.

options.label: Wear it
options.result: It fits. The drowned come for their king. The next fight is an elite.

options.label: Sell it
options.result: A lot of gold. The drowned are looking for you now.

events.title: The Leech Doctor
events.text: A doctor with a jar of leeches. 'Old remedy. Takes the bad blood out. Also some of the good.'

options.label: Treat everyone
options.result: Injuries drawn out. A little blood with them.

options.label: Buy the jar (35 gold)
options.result: They seem happy to come with you.

events.title: The Singer on the Rock
events.text: Someone singing on a rock. The song is about you. It knows things it shouldn't.

check.pass_text: She teaches you two verses of something old.

options.label: Block your ears and pass
options.result: It rings in your ears for a while. Next fight your party starts dazed.

rows.text: She likes it. She throws you a shell full of pearls.
She doesn't. She throws you a curse.

events.title: The Flood Gate
events.text: A great sluice gate, holding back the water. A wheel to open it. Downstream, the drowned are marching toward you.

options.label: Open the gate
options.result: The water takes them and nearly takes you. Next fight, enemies have 30% less HP.

options.label: Jam the wheel
options.result: The gate stays shut. You strip the brass fittings for gold.

events.title: The Drowned Library
events.text: A library where the books have swollen into blocks. A few at the top are still dry.

options.label: Read the dry books
options.result: History, mostly. The kingdom was not what it claimed.

check.fail_text: The books are heavier than you.

options.label: Burn some to dry the rest
options.result: Warm, at least.

events.title: Confession
events.text: A confession box with a veiled figure inside. 'Tell me something true, and I'll take it away from you.'

options.label: Confess a wound
options.result: Every injury in the party is taken away. Something else is too, but you can't say what.

options.label: Confess a fear
options.result: Lighter. Braver. It cost a little blood to say out loud.

options.label: Lie
options.result: She knows. She pays you for the effort and adds a rule.

events.title: Holy Relics
events.text: A deacon guards a table of relics. 'Fingers, knuckles, teeth. All holy. All for sale. Or for faith.'

options.label: Buy a holy relic (45 gold)
options.result: Wrapped in velvet. Still warm.

check.pass_text: Your faith is found adequate. Holy water and a blessing.
check.fail_text: Your faith is found wanting. The test involved knives.

events.title: Elective Surgery
events.text: 'One small improvement,' says the surgeon-priest, sharpening something. 'Nothing you'd miss.'

options.label: Accept the improvement
options.result: Stronger arms. Less of the rest of you.

options.label: Ask for the other improvement
options.result: More of you. It is harder to move it all.

events.title: The Font
events.text: A font of warm red water. 'Everything here heals,' says a gentle voice. 'That is the problem.'

options.label: Bathe
options.result: Fully healed. Next fight your party starts mutating: stronger, softer.

options.label: Bottle some
options.result: Two draughts. They pulse slightly.

options.label: Don't touch it
options.result: Wise. Probably.

events.title: Pilgrims
events.text: Pilgrims crawl toward the altar on their knees. One of them looks up at you. 'Carry me. Please.'

options.label: Carry them
options.result: At the altar they press something into your hand, and crumble.

options.label: Join them
options.result: On your knees. Next fight your party starts sanctified: immune to new debuffs.

options.label: Rob them
options.result: Easy money. Expensive money.

events.title: A Hymn Book
events.text: A hymn book open on a lectern. Most of the hymns are about you.

options.label: Sing one
options.result: The cathedral sings back.

options.label: Tear out your page
options.result: A rule goes with it. Something in the walls is upset.

check.fail_text: It describes something that hasn't happened. Yet.

events.title: The Warm Room
events.text: A round room with soft walls and a heartbeat. It would be very easy to sleep here.

rows.text: You wake up with something new in you.
One of you doesn't wake up straight away.

options.label: Cut your way through
options.result: The room objects.

events.title: The Saint's Statue
events.text: A statue of a smiling saint, arms open. The plaque is scratched out. Her hands are wet.

options.label: Take her hand
options.result: Warm. She doesn't let go for a moment too long.

options.label: Take her halo
options.result: It comes away easily. Something notices. The next fight is an elite.

check.pass_text: SAINT OF NOBODY IN PARTICULAR. HEALS ANYWAY. You understand her better.
check.fail_text: Your fingers bleed. The statue drinks it.

events.title: The Collection Plate
events.text: A brass plate comes down the aisle on its own, stopping in front of you. It waits.

options.label: Give generously (40 gold)
options.result: The cathedral approves.

options.label: Give a card
options.result: It accepts the card. You feel looked after.

options.label: Give nothing
options.result: The plate moves on. Next fight, the cathedral remembers you: your party starts marked.

events.title: The Bone Organ
events.text: An organ built from long bones. The keys are teeth. It plays when you look at it.

check.pass_text: A chord so wrong it stuns. Next fight, enemies start stunned for a turn.

options.label: Take a pipe
options.result: A short pipe of sharpened bone. Useful.

options.label: Smash it
options.result: The congregation comes running.

events.title: The Mirror Saint
events.text: A saint made of mirror. She heals whatever she reflects. She is reflecting your enemies.

check.pass_text: She reflects you now. Healed, and the enemy is weaker next fight.
check.fail_text: She is very heavy and very sharp.

options.label: Break her
options.result: Shards everywhere. One of them is worth keeping.

events.title: Baptism
events.text: 'Every newcomer is baptised,' says the deacon, rolling up his sleeves. The water is thick.

options.label: Submit
options.result: You come up changed. Thicker-skinned, and newly named.

check.pass_text: He comes up spluttering and pays you to go away.

events.title: The Small Reliquary
events.text: A small box of bones that cries when you walk away from it.

options.label: Carry it
options.result: It stops crying. It is very heavy for its size.

options.label: Comfort it
options.result: It goes quiet. So does something in you.

options.label: Walk away fast
options.result: It cries for a long time. Next fight your party starts frightened.

events.title: Stitchwork
events.text: A seamstress who sews people. 'I can close those wounds. My stitches are permanent.'

options.label: Let her stitch everyone
options.result: No more injuries. The stitches pull a little, forever.

options.label: Pay for her best work (40 gold)
options.result: Neat, clean, painless. Expensive.

events.title: Last Rites
events.text: A priest offers to say last rites for your dead. 'It helps the living more than the dead. It always has.'

options.label: Hear them
options.result: Next fight your party starts blessed.

options.label: Ask him to bring one back
options.result: He brings back somebody. Not who you asked for.

events.title: The Thurible
events.text: A censer swinging on its own, filling the nave with sweet smoke. It smells like something you used to love.

options.label: Breathe deep
options.result: Lovely. Next fight your party starts dazed.

options.label: Take the censer
options.result: Two smoke pellets from the coals.

options.label: Hold your breath and run
options.result: Out the other side, gasping.
